title: Unparseable onboarding state silently stops onboarding
current: When the stored onboarding state fails parsing, the run returns 'not due' or 'complete' and logs nothing, so onboarding can stop forever without a trace.
evidence: parseOnboardingState returns undefined for any missing or invalid field. The first read returns not_due; the second read inside runOnboardingCreation returns complete. Neither path calls logDiagnostic.
investigate: What makes the state unparseable (partial hSet, older versions, manual edits)?
Does initializeOnboardingSubscriberGoal repair it, or skip because fields exist?
required: Corrupt state logs at error and is repaired or re-armed.

criticality.why: Onboarding can stop permanently with no log at all.
